Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Stripe Product Accounting Team is responsible for supporting all products at Stripe, consulting on accounting implications and supporting teams' ability to make informed strategic decisions. We are responsible for the accurate and timely recording of all business-generated transactions on our balance sheet and income statement. We operate in a fast-paced environment and collaborate significantly with cross-functional and international teams. 

What you’ll do

Stripe is seeking an experienced accountant to join its world class Accounting team and help us scale for the future, in a fast-paced environment that is growing rapidly. In this role you will support our Payments and Payment Products revenue accounting, leveraging your technical expertise with US GAAP, specifically ASC 606, to quickly identify accounting implications and impacts to customers while advising and collaborating with team members cross-functionally to develop operational processes that help us scale.

Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with our product, go-to-market, and finance partners to thoroughly understand new products, features, and contracts.
  • To leverage your familiarity with US GAAP, specifically ASC 606 (IFRS 15 acceptable), and in-depth understanding of the transaction level processes, to quickly identify the accounting implications of proposed contract terms and product design and collaborate with team members to provide solutions that meet all stakeholders’ objectives
  • Partner closely with our product, go-to-market, and finance partners to thoroughly understand new products, features, and contracts
  • You will be responsible for documenting the Company’s accounting positions and communicating them to varying levels in the organization
  • Partner with internal systems and engineering teams to support internal financial systems and automation of accounting processes
  • Assess the effectiveness of internal controls, and design new processes and controls for emerging and growing business activities
  • Develop and maintain up-to-date accounting procedural documentation
  • Understand balance sheet reconciliations, variance analyses, financial reporting deliverables, and perform analytical reviews
  • Produce internal management analyses and reporting
  • Support external audit processes

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • An accountancy qualification (e.g. CA, CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA) with 3 - 6 years of relevant accounting experience
  • Degree in Accounting or Finance background
  • Working knowledge of US GAAP - ASC 606 (or IFRS 15)
  • The ability to bring structure to ambiguous areas of opportunity and thrive in a fast-moving environment
  • Strong analytical skills and strong knowledge of Google Sheets / Excel
  • An enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves” mentality
  • A passion for creating new systems and solving problems via infrastructure and automation
  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and with different cultures
  • Demonstrated experience with internal controls
  • Ability to be flexible and comfortable with changing requirements

Preferred qualifications

  • CPA/ CA or similar qualification
  • Technical expertise with US GAAP, specifically ASC 606/IFRS 15
  • Knowledge of (or experience in) the technology or payments industry
  • Experience working with Oracle Suite, SalesForce
  • Experience with Hubble and SQL
  • Experience with Analytical Tools like- Power BI, Tableau, KNIME, Python, Alteryx

descriptions.job-0odfbv1:
The department

HR Services is responsible for the systems, processes and data that support the firm’s global HR function. That includes the HR technology estate — Workday alongside Phenom, Peoplefluent and the automation and AI capability developing around them — together with the day-to-day operational service provided to employees and managers throughout the firm.

The function works closely with the HR Information Systems team, People Analytics and with the Finance Systems team who own integrations, and with Technology, Finance and the firm’s control functions.


The role is based in Bangalore and sits alongside the HR Information Systems team there, working with HR colleagues across the firm’s international offices. It requires a consistent working overlap with London, and occasional flexibility around major go-lives and the cyclical processes that run through the HR calendar.


Purpose of the role

We are looking for someone to build the automation and AI capability of our HR function.


HR at Brevan Howard runs on Workday alongside a handful of specialist platforms. A lot of good work happens inside those systems — and a lot of manual work still happens around them, in the gaps between systems, in spreadsheets, and in the steps people continue to do manually. Closing those gaps is this job.


The work spans the whole of HR. Every part of the function has processes worth rebuilding: HR Operations, Talent Acquisition, Reward, HR Business Partnering, Payroll and Employee Relations. It also reaches well beyond HR, because much of what you build will be used by employees and managers directly through self-service or by functions that rely on HRs data for downstream processes. Making those journeys faster, clearer and easier to complete without having to ask anyone for help is a significant part of the role.


You will work with the people who feel the problem, find what should not be manual, build something that fixes it, and put better information in front of those making decisions. You will have real ownership of projects from the start, with the support to do them well. Alongside that you will learn Workday properly: the firm will fund your Workday training, including certification where appropriate, and give you the time to build genuine depth in it. The role gives exposure across the whole of HR, exposure through working partnerships with Finance Systems and Technology, and a clear path into HR technology, systems or data roles.


This role will suit someone with up to two years' experience, including internships and substantial projects, building automations, tools or reporting, ideally with a strong technical degree from an IIT, NIT or comparable institution, who now wants to specialise in HR technology.


Main duties and responsibilities

Automation and AI tools

·        Build automations that take repetitive manual work out of HR processes — joiners and leavers, reporting cycles, approvals, data checks and document production.

·        Build AI-assisted tools that the HR team will use day to day, such as finding answers across policies and documents, summarising data, and triaging incoming queries.

·        Work with colleagues across HR Globally to find where effort is being wasted, and prioritise by the manual work removed and the risk reduced.

·        Maintain what you have built, including monitoring, handling failures, and revisiting a tool when something upstream changes.

Employee and manager self-service

·        Improve the employee and manager self-service experience — simplifying journeys, reducing the number of steps needed to complete a task, and removing the points where people get stuck.

·        Build tools that answer common employee and manager questions directly, so that routine queries do not need a ticket.

·        Make sure self-service works equally well for colleagues in every location, and for those whose circumstances are not the standard case.


Reporting and dashboards

·        Build and maintain dashboards that give teams across HR, and the leadership group, a clear and current view of their data.

·        Support recurring reporting cycles and respond to ad hoc requests for analysis.

·        Find the cause when data is wrong, rather than correcting the symptom.


Workday and the wider HR systems estate

·        Learn Workday configuration and reporting, and take on system work as you do — this is how you will come to understand the estate you are automating.

·        Work with the HR Information Systems team on anything that requires configuration within a platform, and with the Finance Systems team where automation reaches an integration.

·        Build to the firm’s design, security and documentation standards for HR systems, with support from the HR IS Architecture and Governance Lead.

·        Document what you build, clearly enough that it outlasts you.


Working with others

·        Translate between HR colleagues and technical counterparts in both directions, so that each understands what the other needs.

·        Explain what a tool does, what it cannot do, and where a person still needs to make the decision.

·        Raise anything that processes personal data in a new way, or that would replace a human judgement, before building it.


Person specification

We are looking for up to two years' relevant experience, which can include internships, and evidence that you have built something that works, and that you can explain how. That experience might come from a previous job or projects during your study.


Experience and background

Essential

  • Proven hands-on experience building automations or AI-assisted tools. This can come from work, study or your own projects — a script, a workflow, an agent, a chatbot or a working prototype.
  • Programming ability in Python, with working knowledge of SQL.
  • Experience working with data: cleaning it, joining it, presenting it, and recognising when the numbers are wrong.
  • A degree in computer science, engineering or a related technical subject, or equivalent demonstrable ability.

Desirable

  • A relevant degree from an IIT, NIT or comparable institution, ideally in computer science, engineering or a related subject.
  • Any exposure to Workday, or other HR ERPs in any capacity.
  • Experience with an automation or workflow platform.
  • Experience building with large language models, for example document Q&A or retrieval tools.
  • Dashboarding in Power BI or a comparable tool.
  • An understanding of APIs and how systems exchange data.
  • Any previous experience in an HR, People or shared services team.
  • Awareness of data protection considerations where personal data is processed.

Technical and business skills
Essential

  • Able to explain technical work clearly to people who are not technical.
  • Careful and accurate. HR data drives pay and access, so mistakes matter and checking twice is part of the job.
  • Able to work independently. Much of this has not been done here before, and nobody will hand you a backlog.
  • Able to document work to a standard someone else can pick up.
  • Sound judgement and discretion with confidential information about people.
  • Strong written and spoken English.

Desirable

  • Experience gathering requirements from people who know the problem but not the solution.
  • Interest in how AI tools are evaluated, and in where they should and should not be used.
  • Experience working with colleagues in more than one country or time zone.

About Us

Founded 20 years ago and headquartered in Chicago, the DV>DV Group of financial services firms has grown to more than 600 people operating throughout North America, Europe and Asia. Since spinning out of a large brokerage firm in 2016, DV Trading has rapidly scaled as an independent proprietary trading firm utilizing its own capital, trading strategies, and risk management methodologies to provide liquidity to worldwide financial markets and hedging opportunities to commodity producers and users. Now, DV group affiliates include two broker dealers, a cryptocurrency market making firm, and a bourgeoning investment adviser.

Overview

DV Trading is seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Global Payroll Accountant to join our London office.  You’ll support payroll operations across nine countries: the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates (Dubai), Spain, Poland, Denmark, Hong Kong, and Singapore.

The UK is a core part of this role. London-based payroll for the UK is processed through Paycom, alongside the US and Canada. The remaining six jurisdictions are handled through TMF Group, which provides dedicated local payroll specialists in each country.

You’ll work closely with our US-based Global Payroll Accountant. Primary responsibilities are divided between the two roles, and you’ll both build a strong understanding of our global payroll operations and provide backup coverage for each other. You’ll also work with international teams and external payroll providers.

Responsibilities

  • Process payroll for your assigned countries, validating inputs such as new hires, terminations, salary changes, bonuses, and benefits before approval.
  • Review payroll registers and variance reports, and resolve discrepancies with Paycom, TMF Group, and internal teams.
  • Post payroll journal entries, reconcile payroll to the general ledger, and maintain payroll balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Coordinate with HR and Treasury on deadlines, funding, and statutory remittances.
  • Support accruals, year-end tax documentation, and payroll-related audits.
  • Document procedures and processing calendars and look for ways to improve controls and efficiency.

Requirements

  • A bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • At least 3 years in payroll processing, payroll accounting, or a related role.
  • Strong knowledge of UK payroll, including PAYE, National Insurance, and statutory requirements.
  • Experience with payroll systems and external providers, and an understanding of payroll journal entries and reconciliations.
  • Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables and lookups.
  • Excellent organization, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
  • Discretion with confidential employee and financial information.

 Preferred: 

  • Experience coordinating payroll across multiple countries.
  • Familiarity with Paycom, TMF Group, or similar international payroll providers.
  • CIPP, AAT, ACCA, CIMA, or similar professional qualifications, completed or in progress.
  • Experience working in financial services, trading, or another fast-paced industry.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics GP or comparable accounting software.
  • Experience supporting payroll-related financial audits and statutory reporting.

All resumes submitted by search firms to DV via e-mail, the Internet, personal delivery, facsimile, or any other method without a valid written agreement shall be deemed the sole property of DV, and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by DV. About the job

  • Formal business education or training is a plus (MBA, CFA progress, or equivalent practical commercial experience).

  • Demonstrated experience with strategy consulting methods and structured problem solving (hypothesis-driven analysis, market and competitive assessment).

  • Working knowledge of transaction structures and documentation (term sheets, SPAs, shareholder agreements) and of acquisition financing instruments.

  • Strong financial modelling and valuation skills.

  • Ability to translate complex commercial, operational, and financial information into clear investment recommendations.

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with financial databases (e.g., Capital IQ, Bloomberg, PitchBook) is an advantage.

  • English fluent

  • Attention to detail and sound commercial judgement.

Preferred / Advantageous

  • Experience with cross-border transactions.

  • Additional languages and willingness to travel to target companies, assets, and counterparties.

Every vendor, supplier, contractor and counterparty that works with Bitdeer in North America arrives through commercial paper first, and you will own that paper end to end — non-disclosure agreements, vendor and supplier onboarding, purchase order terms, and templated negotiations.

We will be straightforward about the shape of the work. Much of it is standard paper run against templates and pre-approved positions — and that is deliberate. Few lawyers get to put hundreds of agreements through their own hands in their first years, and almost none get to do it on infrastructure at this scale. The counterparties are transformer manufacturers, EPC contractors, power developers and compute customers, and the paper attaches to gigawatt-scale data center projects. The North America legal function is five lawyers and still being built. The template library, the negotiation playbook and the standards this work runs on are being written right now, and you will help write them from the ground level rather than inherit them. Alongside the routine tier you will carry named workstreams on larger EPC, procurement, land and power matters with senior colleagues, and you will have a say in how the function uses AI in drafting and review. Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The Team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken's engineers build a lot of software. Developer Platform AI builds the AI systems they use to do it: agents that write and review code, simple access to the best models in the tools they already use, and the infrastructure that connects AI to our internal systems.

This is a small team with a lot of reach. The tools you ship will change how engineers across Kraken work every day, and you'll see that happen directly. The work spans agent platforms, code review, LLM routing and cost controls, MCP integrations with tools like Slack, Jira and GitLab, and the security and observability that make all of it safe to run.

If you want to work on applied AI with real users from day one, this is that job.

 

The Opportunity

  • LLM traffic doesn't behave like normal API traffic. Requests are long-running, streaming and expensive. One prompt can cost a few cents or a few dollars. One team's burst can burn another team's budget. Providers change their rate limits, failure modes and pricing without warning. Running this well is a problem few companies have solved, and it's the job.

    • Own the reliability of the platform engineers depend on: the AI Gateway, the agent runtime and the connections to internal tools. Set the SLOs, own the error budgets and decide what happens when they're spent.

    • Design resilience across model providers: routing, failover, retries, rate limiting and graceful degradation when a provider is slow, throttling or down.

    • Make LLM traffic legible. Build observability that shows latency, errors, token usage and cost by team, model and use case, so engineers can see what their workloads cost and where they're spending their time waiting.

    • Treat capacity and cost as one problem. Routing decisions affect both latency and spend, and you'll own the tradeoff directly.

    • Work with Security, Finance and AI governance to put access controls, budgets, audit logging and data handling into the platform, not into a spreadsheet next to it.

    • Lead incident response and blameless post-incident reviews. Turn what breaks into fixes that stay fixed.

    • Automate operations with infrastructure as code, safe deployments and progressive rollouts, so the platform gets more reliable as it grows rather than more fragile.

    • Mentor engineers and raise the operating standard across the team.

    This is a Staff role. You'll set the technical direction for how the platform runs, not just keep it running. The platform is small enough that your decisions shape it directly, and used broadly enough that they affect every engineering team at Kraken.

Skills You Should HODL

  • Extensive experience in site reliability, infrastructure or platform engineering, with a track record of owning high-traffic, business-critical services in production

  • Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes, a major cloud provider and infrastructure as code such as Terraform

  • Strong command of SLOs, observability and incident management, and the judgment to know which reliability work actually matters

  • Proficiency in Rust or Python, and comfort reading and changing a production service's code

  • Experience with API gateways, reverse proxies or traffic management: load balancing, rate limiting, failover and caching

  • Experience operating multi-tenant internal platforms, including authentication, authorization and per-tenant cost controls

  • Staff-level influence: you set direction across teams, write clear design documents and bring other engineers with you


Nice to Haves

  • Experience operating LLM gateways or integrating LLM provider APIs at scale: streaming, token-based rate limiting, model routing and caching

  • Experience serving models yourself, including vLLM or Ray: GPU scheduling, batching, autoscaling and cost per token

  • Experience building Kubernetes controllers or operators with controller-runtime or kubebuilder

  • Experience with Consul and Vault for service discovery, configuration and secrets

  • Experience with model evaluation pipelines for catching quality regressions before and after rollout

  • Familiarity with coding agents and agent harnesses, and running them safely in sandboxed environments

  • Experience with cost attribution, budgeting or FinOps for usage-based services

  • Background in security-sensitive or regulated environments such as financial services or crypto

  • Contributions to open-source gateway, proxy or observability projects

About Bullish

Bullish is an institutionally focused global digital asset platform that provides market infrastructure and information services. Bullish Exchange is regulated in Germany, Hong Kong, and Gibraltar. CoinDesk Indices – a collection of tradable proprietary and single-asset benchmarks and indices that track the performance of digital assets for global institutions in the digital assets and traditional finance industries. CoinDesk Data - a broad suite of digital assets market data and analytics, providing real-time insights into prices, trends, and market dynamics. CoinDesk Insights – a digital asset media and events provider and operator of Coindesk.com, a digital media platform that covers news and insights about digital assets, the underlying markets, policy, and blockchain technology.

Reports to:

Chief Compliance Officer, US Regulated Entities

Position Overview
We are seeking a BSA/AML Officer with deep Blockchain Compliance expertise to play a key role in the business expansion of our regulated US digital currency trading business. In this role, you will support the spot, derivative, and tokenized securities business lines in the US, encompassing the MTL businesses (spot), FCM, and Broker Dealer entities. As the BSA/AML Officer, you will be responsible for our BSA/AML & OFAC Sanctions programs and ensuring that we maintain compliance with all applicable local, US, and international laws and regulations impacting the digital currency industry. You will also bring specialized knowledge of blockchain structures, networks, and on-chain activities to help our U.S. businesses develop and implement appropriate processes and controls supporting spot trading, derivatives, and tokenized securities activities..

This position is based in NYC and will be required to work from our NYC office. The role reports to the US Chief Compliance Officer.


Responsibilities:


BSA/AML & Sanctions Oversight

  • Lead the compliance program for tokenized securities, derivatives, and spot crypto trading to meet all applicable state and federal regulatory requirements and reflect the nature of a rapidly changing risk landscape, including:
    • BSA/AML compliance;
    • Sanctions compliance;
    • fraud risk;
    • market integrity;
    • Compliance with state licensing requirements;
  • Implement the domestic BSA/AML and OFAC compliance programs in line with U.S. regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain risk-based BSA/AML and OFAC policies and procedures addressing all areas of BSA/AML and OFAC; advise Bullish staff and management of deficiencies and ensure that required changes are made.
  • Direct the domestic BSA/AML and OFAC compliance monitoring program to ensure there are sufficient internal controls to promote an effective control environment.
  • Coordinate with offshore affiliates and exercise oversight to ensure any controls performed on behalf of the U.S. entity by the affiliates are performed to a standard that meets U.S. requirements.
  • Oversee regulatory reporting to FinCEN, SEC, CFTC, FINRA, NFA, NYDFS, and other federal and state regulators, as necessary, to comply with Bullish’s BSA/AML reporting obligations, including ensuring the timely filing of suspicious activity reports (“SARs”).
  • Prepare monthly and quarterly management reporting of BSA/AML-related metrics.
  • Identify, escalate, track, and remediate, as necessary, BSA/AML compliance-related issues.
  • Perform BSA/AML, CIP, and OFAC risk assessments as needed and work with stakeholders and various forms of data to inform, update, streamline and optimize the BSA/AML and OFAC program.
  • Lead the process for ensuring all BSA/AML and OFAC reports are filed as required and all BSA/AML and OFAC related records are maintained according to regulatory requirements.
  • Contribute to building a compliance culture across the firm by training Bullish employees on key policies, procedures, and their responsibilities in preventing financial crime.

Blockchain Intelligence & Tokenization Compliance

  • Act as the lead compliance investigator and subject-matter specialist for blockchain analytics, wallet clustering, and transaction tracing across spot trading, derivatives margin/settlement, and tokenized assets.
  • Conduct hands-on forensic investigations into flagged deposit and withdrawal addresses using enterprise blockchain tools (e.g., Chainalysis, TRM Labs, Elliptic), tracing funds through bridges, decentralized protocols, and mixing services.

  • Assess proposed token listings, blockchain networks, smart contract upgrades, and bridge mechanisms for financial crime, sanctions, and other compliance risks.
  • Translate on-chain transaction activity and smart contract data into actionable findings to support suspicious activity investigations, regulatory reporting, and law enforcement requests.
